text: Evening. I'm minding my granddaughter, she's 7, she's got chickenpox, the itchy spots all over, otherwise she seems well enough I think. Her temperature is 37.8. I'm frightened I'll miss something, I haven't dealt with this since my own were small and I don't remember what's normal. She's wide awake, talking nonstop, watching telly, so I suppose that's a good sign? Not sure if I should be doing more than calamine and keeping her nails short.
